description: D29 N2: a conflict answer other than Delete entry (Keep entry, Update governance, Defer) writes only the entry's Governance-conflict record. A replace is the old entry once both lose their Governance-conflict lines (a rewrite that drops the human: actor, a changed Why and an added Affirmed line are refused); an append_lines is Governance-conflict lines alone. The matching replace and append_lines are applied.
